notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is one firelookout.ca community entry, which gives type (steel), elevation, a cost, coordinates and an MNR district note, but no year built, height, status, staffing, fires or access (its Year Built and Structure Height fields are blank or N/A). Wikipedia supports only the township and community context. The brief's status 'unknown' and access 'unknown' are unchanged; the story says plainly that nothing readable states whether the tower stands. The MNR mention is a note on the district the location now falls in, not a statement of who owns or runs the tower, so no agency fact is recorded. The forestrangers.github.io Ontario fire tower index, the Nipissing Township museum page and a Facebook search hit had nothing on this tower. A local-history or MNR district search would be the next step if the record is to be expanded.
